def is_safe_name(name: str) -> bool:
    """True when name is one plain path component: non-empty, not "." or "..", and free of "/", "\\" and NUL characters."""
    ex is_safe_name("a.txt") == True
    ex is_safe_name("") == False
    ex is_safe_name("..") == False
    ex is_safe_name("../secret") == False
    ex is_safe_name("/etc/passwd") == False
    ex is_safe_name("sub\\x") == False
    if name == "" or name == "." or name == "..":
        return False
    for bad in ["/", "\\", "\0"]:
        if bad in name:
            return False
    return True

def read_note(name: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Text of the file `name` inside the directory `notes`, read with fs confined to `notes`. Returns "" when the name is unsafe (any path escaping `notes`), or the file is missing or unreadable."""
    post is_safe_name(name) or out == ""
    if not is_safe_name(name):
        return ""
    result = ""
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        result = fs.read_text(name) else ""
    return result
